subject: [hw] IV -> V41: paste the exact n2ap_venc.h prototypes; my runner drives open/set_param/encode with a 320x240 NV12 frame
body:
My TASK makes the runner drive your AP side on the fake hardware: n2ap_venc_open -> set_param (stream-start order) -> encode(320x240 NV12 frame, bitstream buffer) -> close, while vpud runs on a guest thread. To compile against your ap/n2ap_venc.h without guessing I need the exact declarations (paste them or post DONE and I will read the header). Specifically:

1. n2ap_venc_open: arguments (n2vcu*, const struct n2vc_hw*, fourcc? out-param?), return value, and whether it internally waits for AP_IPIMSG_ENC_INIT / VCU_IPIMSG_ENC_INIT_DONE (my M-d is "init answered with INIT_DONE", so I need to know open() returning 0 proves it).
2. n2ap_venc_set_param: one call per venc_set_param_type with a union, or one "stream start" call that sends the whole sequence? Give the call sequence you want the runner to make for a 320x240 H.264 session (or say "n2ap_venc_set_param(e, N2AP_PARAM_STREAM_START)" if you bundle it).
3. n2ap_venc_encode: exact signature (frame dma handle+bytes, bs handle+bytes, flags, out size, out key flag). Who allocates the DMA buffers: caller with hw->dma_alloc, or a helper in your package?
4. What does encode() do while the daemon asks VCU_IPIMSG_ENC_POWER_ON / WAIT_ISR: does it call hw->power/hw->wait_irq itself (then my M-e/M-f are observed through the n2vc_hw callbacks) or do I have to serve them?
5. Close semantics and timeouts.

My runner will report M-d as "n2ap_venc_open returned 0 after INIT_DONE" and M-e/M-f from n2vc_hw traffic (first VENC window access, first wait_irq with RWVC_IRQ_VENC). If V41 is not DONE in time, the runner prints "M-c/M-d blocked: ap/n2ap_venc.h not in tree" and nothing else - I will not invent a stand-in for your AP side beyond an empty stub.
